prompts.frost-revenant:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production pixel-art enemy animation spritesheet for a side-scrolling Thai fantasy RPG.
Create ONE ICE REVENANT BOSS: a massive sinister undead knight in jagged cyan ice armor, dark steel joints, icy antler crown, glowing blue eyes, wielding a large frost halberd. Distinct, readable chunky silhouette, beautifully drawn 16-bit pixel art, dark 2-pixel outlines, 48-color palette, pixel clusters, NO antialiasing or blur.
Exact sheet layout: 4 equal columns x 6 equal rows, 24 frames, portrait canvas 1024x1536, each cell 256x256. Transparent background with true alpha. No text, borders, labels, shadows, ground, UI, or scenery. All poses full body, side view facing RIGHT, same scale, feet aligned at y=232 within EVERY cell, centered at x=128. Keep all artwork inside each cell with 14px clear margin, including weapon and attack effects.
Row 1: four idle breathing frames, halberd ready.
Row 2: four walking cycle frames.
Row 3: four halberd attack frames: windup, raised weapon, impactful forward slash with a compact cyan ice arc, recovery.
Row 4: four damage reaction frames: impact, recoil, stagger, recovery.
Row 5: four death frames: kneel, collapse, body on ground, ice fragments dissolving near ground.
Row 6: four spawn frames: ice shards near ground, rising silhouette, standing up, idle.
Maintain exactly the SAME knight design in all 24 cells. Fit the full character in every cell. Grounded humanoid, no wings.

Subject: An original squat horned FURNACE DEMON, massive charcoal-black iron body with orange lava cracks, roaring furnace mouth in its belly, two thick legs, spiked black shoulders, glowing eyes, gripping a huge iron forging hammer. A fiery red mane and short curling bull horns. Powerful readable silhouette, menacing fantasy enemy, NOT an ice knight or stone golem. Attack is a heavy hammer smash producing compact orange sparks. Death leaves black iron fragments and embers. Spawn from coals. Warm charcoal, rust red and bright orange palette.

prompts.storm-roc:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art boss spritesheet, side-scrolling fantasy RPG.
